hero.title: Plan your Siargao trip

featured.title: Sugba Lagoon
featured.subtitle: Turquoise lagoon in the mangroves. Paddle board, swim, jump.

featured.title: Guyam Island
featured.subtitle: A tiny palm island 15 minutes by boat from General Luna.

featured.title: Magpupungko rock pools
featured.subtitle: Natural pools that appear at low tide on the east coast.

note.title: Best time to go
note.body: March to October is the drier stretch. November to February brings more rain and rougher boat rides, so keep a spare day in your plan.
